svg.title: Proposition 39: Finite-data quantum model-set non-factorization certification
svg.desc: What this figure shows: Proved finite-data model-set theorem. P39 converts the exact P38 quantum factorization criterion into a confidence statement that remains valid when the quantum operational description and the independently defined target are both uncertain.. Visible guideposts include: Finite data certify a model-class-relative contradiction only after quantum and target uncertainty are carried explicitly.; QUANTUM UNCERTAINTY; Tomography confidence set; CQ ⊂ HQ; Pr(h* ∈ CQ) ≥ 1−αQ; Each h encodes exact operational-state fibers.. How to read it: follow the diagram in the direction of its arrows and use each box, panel, inequality, or highlighted region only with the meaning printed beside it. Main takeaway: this is the visual companion to Proposition 39; the proposition document supplies the assumptions, proof, and exact scope of every implication. Scientific status: Proposition 39 theorem/certificate visual. It is not independent empirical evidence and does not, by itself, identify a physical or latent variable with consciousness.
svg.text: Finite data certify a model-class-relative contradiction only after quantum and target uncertainty are carried explicitly.
Each h encodes exact operational-state fibers.
Target definition remains independent of qh.
Lxx′ > 0 proves the true target laws differ
Search only exact state fibers of h
Every surviving quantum model must fail
close tomography estimates ≠ exact state equality
A positive P39 certificate rejects the declared quantum confidence set as sufficient for the target; it does not prove quantum mechanics incomplete.
